DeterminationBasis: T16-003 directly falsifies unsupported representation as externally certified and requires the stronger status to be refused, corrected or marked NOT_ESTABLISHED unless supporting evidence exists. This covers WORD-002's boundary that a LILP conformance result cannot, by itself, be described as certified absent a separately established certification basis authorising that wording.

Existing T16 controls can identify a claimed profile, evaluate profile completeness and disclose self-assessment in public or recipient-facing contexts, but no existing control requires the declared profile itself to accompany the public conformance claim at the point of presentation. WORD-007 therefore requires a distinct public-claim/profile-accompaniment control.
